decision: Drop of 10 grid positions, 3rd MGU-K (1st 3rd element used).
event_name: Aston Martin Red Bull Racing Document 36 Date 27 May 2018 Time 13:09 2018 MONACO GRAND PRIX 23 - 27 May 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 35), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: 3rd Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGU-K) has been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 (a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Drop of 10 grid positions, 3rd MGU-K (1st 3rd element used).
reason: A 10 grid position penalty is imposed as detailed above in accordance with Articles 23.3 a) and 23.3 b). The team notified the Technical Delegate regarding the change of the power unit elements on the 26th May, at 18:10. Nish Shetty Jose Abed Danny Sullivan Eric Barrabino
title: 2018 Monaco Grand Prix Offence Car 33 3Rd Mgu K36
